author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: stick figure in crescent lunge with an open circular head exactly 8 above the neck on the upright torso axis (head centre (22,10), r4, neck (22,22): 12 - 4 = 8; neck is the nearest body point), an arm raised forward-up from the shoulder, front thigh level with the shin dropping to the floor, back leg extended long to the lower-left. A first candidate with a leaning torso put the head on the lean (exact 13 = r5 + 8) but left only a stub torso, so the raised arm read as the body. The rejected drawing had a dotted head and a torso fused with the arm.
omissions: The raised arm is angled forward (to (37,13)) rather than nearly vertical: a steeper arm from the shoulder would pass within 8 of the head. The torso is upright rather than slightly leaning back.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'person-standing' single-stroke limbs; human proportions from icon_set/references/human_ref/full_body_ref.png.
